graph.title: Valentine Panda
notes: The manual is a picture-only booklet and the PDF text gives no per-step parts boxes. I inferred which piece goes in which step from the thumbnails, so the exact stud positions, and some of the placements, are approximate.

The piece count matches the official list: 53 pieces. The 3x white 1x2 plate + white curved 2x2 sub-assembly from step 17 is a repeat (6 pieces). The other 47 pieces are listed as parts, ids b1 to b53 with b38 to b43 skipped.
The 3023/15068 sub-assembly attaches to three places. Stud positions on those attachment points were guessed from the step 17 and 18 pictures.
Step 16 sub-assembly (tail): white 2x2 plate + jumper plate + black round tile, plus the 4th white curved 2x2 brick (b44) as I read it. b44 is joined to the same 2x2 plate.
The heart (b53), the black 99206 plate (b34) and the black curved 2x1 pieces (b18, b19) are joined with best-guess studs. The picture is ambiguous on which side studs of the red bricks they use.
All connections are stud/anti-stud push-on joins, rigid and removable by hand. There are no pins, axles or hinges.
